title: Details of father's drum kit, sticks and brushes
summary: Arthur describes the wood block, cymbal and pedal setup, and says no wire brushes were used then.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Now, do you remember anything about how many traps they used, that is, in the way of cowbells, or other cymbals, or wood blocks, or anything else that he had?

Well, he had a wood box, I can remember that well, because I watched him play. He had a wood box, he had those cymbals hang, you know, that you beat on it. He had one on the side of the drum. The pedal hit. Yeah, the pedal hit. I can remember that set of drums well. I remember that he did have that on it.
How big a snare drum, what kind of a snare, was it a deep one made of metal, or wood, or anything? This was a metal drum.

Metal. Beautiful thing, it was all nickel-plated. That's the drum that I remember well, the only one I can remember, the one he had from Julie, because he used to talk about it so much, and just before he died, he left it to me, and I could remember that one. He had the ordinary big bass drum, but that drum was always about this wide. Eight inches or something. About eight inches or so, and it was the regular size of the regular snap drum, but it was about eight inches wide. Yeah. And it was all nickel-plated. It was a pretty thing.
You don't remember anything about the type of sticks he used or anything?
No, I don't remember. I just remember they were drum sticks. I don't remember exactly what type. Did they ever use anything like wire brushes?
You know, a lot of the drummers now use those wire brushes.

No, I didn't see anything like that in the times when he played. I didn't see wire brushes. They didn't have wire brushes when I seen them out there. They used to beat on, they had a little tum tum drum on the side. They used to beat on that with a stick.
They used to beat on that with a little Chinese thumb down.

Yeah, but I never did see those wire brushes. Tell them the later years after I'd grown up, then I seen them. Well, he was dead and gone when I seen those wire brushes. They didn't use them in them days.
